Container.Name: loklm-knowledge
Container.Overview: Headless LokLM file knowledge service. Build locally using deploy/knowledge/Dockerfile. Requires separately configured LiveSync and CouchDB. No public port mapping. Keep derived index on local SSD and outside the vault. Read deploy/knowledge/README.md before first installation.

Config.Name: Local SSD index
Config.Description: Derived private index, never SMB or LiveSync

Config.Name: API token file
Config.Description: Private token file, not token text
